description: This file defines the RqlOptionParser class, which implements the OptionParser interface for parsing and serializing RQL options as per the standard. It includes methods for parsing options from a string, serializing options to a string, and maintains internal constants for delimiters and the parser instance.

classes.name: RqlOptionParser
classes.description: Final class implementing OptionParser interface for RQL options parsing and serialization.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an input string into a list of Options using the internal parser.

methods.name: parseOptions
methods.description: Static method that provides a convenience around the parse method to parse options from a string.

methods.name: unparse
methods.description: Serializes a list of Option objects into a single string, delimited by commas, maintaining bidirectional parseability.
